items.detail: PatentTerminalParseError: Largan Family 76895572 item 1; paragraphs 63-73, FIGS. 1A-1F and TABLE 1 publish the first light-blocking-opening imaging-lens-assembly architecture. The exact source publishes no ordered optical lens-surface radius sequence, ordered axial intersurface spacing, numerical optical material/index/dispersion row, surface-specific conic/asphere coefficient, source-bound focal length and F-number, or absolute image height. Lens count, convex/concave ordinal labels, aperture-stop function, maximum deployment FOV and D/A/R/dmin opening geometry remain architecture metadata; the published curvature radius belongs to a light-blocking opening arc, not a lens surface. Claims 1-14 add no separate ordered prescription. No value is derived, measured from drawings, transcribed from raster, or borrowed from parent application 17/249182, prior US-20240069305-A1, another family or a shared layout
